content.text: ▪︎smoking, silica exposure, UV light, EBV infection, drugs (procainamide, hydralazine)
, discoid rash (annular, erythematous patches w/ keratotic scaling that heal w/ scarring),
» hematologic (petechiae, pallor, recurrent infections d/t cytopenias)
» heart (pericarditis, myocarditis, endocarditis, aortic valve lesions, CAD)
» lungs (pneumonitis, interstitial lung disease, pulmonary HTN)
» neurologic (seizures, psychosis, personality changes, lupus cerebritis, aseptic meningitis, neuropathy)
may have frequent miscarriages & livedo reticularis
: constitutional, cutaneous, MSK, or hematologic SXS
, sun protection, smoking cessation, aerobic exercise
▪︎HCQ take ~3mo for clinical effect to be observed
▪︎prednisone tapered once HCQ has taken effect
